LEQVIO contains inclisiran sodium, a small interfering RNA (siRNA) directed to proprotein convertase subtilisin kexin type 9 (PCSK9) mRNA.

key_safety.text: Most notable safety issue was injection site reactions, occurring in 8.2% of inclisiran patients vs 1.8% on placebo. Other common adverse reactions (≥3%) included arthralgia (5.0% vs 4.0%), urinary tract infection (4.4% vs 3.6%), diarrhea (3.9% vs 3.5%), and bronchitis (4.3% vs 2.7%).

summary.text: Leqvio (inclisiran) was submitted as a new molecular entity NDA received December 23, 2019, supported by three randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 trials (ORION-9, ORION-10, ORION-11); a Complete Response Letter was issued December 18, 2020 for lack of an acceptable drug product facility inspection, and the drug was approved following the Class 2 Complete Response resubmission received July 1, 2021, on the basis of durable, statistically significant LDL-C lowering.
